plaatsen.tekst: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather
And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
